name: indodax-cli
description: AI-Native Kraken-style MCP server and CLI for the Indodax exchange. Fully optimized for LLMs with machine-readable tool/error catalogs and workflow skills. Supports real-time market data, portfolio management, secure spot trading with previews, paper trading, and WebSocket streams. Native support for Claude Desktop (STDIO) and mobile/cloud agents (HTTP Bridge) with multi-user isolation.
